summary: Iteration 4 large-scope test PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest checks in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py PASS in 6.74s covering (a) CSRF double-submit middleware — login returns csrf_token+sets non-httpOnly cookie, POST without X-CSRF-Token = 403, POST with header = 200, GET /api/auth/csrf re-issues fresh token, pure Bearer (no cookies) bypasses CSRF as designed; (b) regression on all pre-iter4 endpoints (auth/me, bot/*, market/*, trades, pnl, wallet, logs, telegram, exchange-keys, worker/health); (c) Users CRUD — create viewer, promote→admin, revert→viewer, delete; bootstrap admin demote=409, delete=409, self-delete=409; (d) Role enforcement — viewer gets 403 on bot/action, bot/config PUT, telegram/test, exchange-keys POST, GETs work; (e) Per-key permissions — LIVE mode blocked with 409 when no trade-perm key exists, succeeds after PATCH /exchange-keys/Binance/permissions ['read','trade']; (f) PnL series — ?hours=24→25 buckets, ?hours=6→7 buckets, ?hours=200 capped to 168→169 buckets, each bucket has {ts,label,pnl,trades,cumulative}; (g) Public /api/public/stats requires NO auth, returns name/version/status/mode/pnl/exchanges/symbols/series_24h(25 pts). Frontend: Public /share renders without auth (data-testid='share-page' + 'share-chart' + exchange/symbol chips + auto-refresh 8s footer). Admin login → Dashboard shows pnl-chart-card with 6h/24h/72h/168h range buttons all present and clickable, pnl-chart-cum pill updates, user-role-pill='admin', open-share-link present. Users page (data-testid='users-page') renders, Add User form creates 'uitest_viewer@arbhft.io' viewer row successfully. Viewer login: role pill='viewer', sidebar HIDES API Keys, Bot Config, Users, Telegram (visible: Dashboard, Spreads, Trades, Wallet, Logs). Dashboard master-control buttons (PAPER/LIVE/Start/Stop/Restart) render visibly greyed/disabled in viewer mode (confirmed via screenshot). Test viewer user cleaned up (DELETE 200).

issues: React Router v7 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — harmless deprecation notices, not a defect.

critical_code_review_comments: CSRF middleware is well-implemented: double-submit cookie + secrets.compare_digest constant-time compare; correctly skips when no csrf_token cookie present so pure-bearer CLI/test clients still work; correctly enforces when cookie IS present.

FastAPI lifespan() context manager replaces deprecated @app.on_event — startup creates indexes + seeds admin + spawns background_tick & worker_probe_loop tasks; shutdown cancels tasks and calls worker_client.aclose(). Clean.
require_admin dependency is properly chained on every write/admin endpoint (bot/action, bot/mode, bot/config PUT, telegram, exchange-keys POST/PATCH/DELETE, users POST/PATCH/DELETE).
Per-key permission gate via _trade_keys_present() is correctly evaluated for BOTH POST /bot/mode (live) AND POST /bot/action (start/restart while in live mode). 409 used appropriately.

MINOR: bot_state, bot_config, pnl_state are module-level dicts (in-memory) — restart wipes runtime mode/uptime/pnl_today but trades & logs are persisted in Mongo. Acceptable for a single-node control panel; if scaled out, hoist these to Mongo too.
MINOR: /api/users PATCH allows changing password but does not invalidate the user's existing JWT (no token revocation list). For an admin tool this is acceptable, but worth noting.
MINOR: server.py is now ~890 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting routers (auth.py, bot.py, users.py, exchange_keys.py, public.py) when iter 5 lands.
MINOR: /api/auth/csrf is a GET that mutates server state (sets a new cookie). Idempotent enough but technically a side-effect on GET — could be POST to be RESTful-pure.

MINOR: Dashboard master-control buttons in viewer mode have no data-testid='bot-action-{start|stop|restart}' / data-testid='bot-mode-{paper|live}' attributes; they render disabled but lack stable testids. Adding them would help future testing agents target the disabled-state assertion programmatically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (share-page no-auth, admin pnl-chart + range buttons + cum pill + role pill + open-share-link, users-page create flow, viewer role-pill + sidebar gating + disabled controls)

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Initial Playwright run failed during the viewer-login phase because the logout selector used a comma-separated text/data-testid expression that Playwright treated as a single CSS query, leaving the session still authenticated as admin. Worked around by calling /api/auth/logout via fetch() and clearing context cookies; second pass verified the viewer flow cleanly.
